summary.intent: Use the GSD manager to run discuss sessions for three security/integrity phases (42: API unpin authorization, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) on the cipher-box project, producing CONTEXT.md decision documents for each.
summary.outcome: All three discuss sessions completed and committed. Phase 42 decided on silent 2XX + audit log with transactional outbox and per-CID lock. Phase 43 locked FUSE write-durability decisions. Phase 44 locked four IPNS conflict-handling decisions. CONTEXT.md, DISCUSSION-LOG.md, and DISCUSS-CHECKPOINT.json written and committed for each phase.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) is behind JwtAuthGuard only — signup is open (Web3Auth), so any account holder can unpin any CID. The handler never reads req.user.

Kubo runs with the 'server' profile (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72), which only disables LAN discovery but keeps full public DHT participation on swarm port 4001 — every pinned CID is advertised via DHT crawlers.
The Kubo API (port 5001) has been loopback-only since Phase 29; the API endpoint is the only external path in.
Content-addressed dedup means one CID can be shared across multiple users, making cross-tenant unpin a low-effort data-destruction attack.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin (shared-write.ts:450) — there is no live cross-user legitimate unpin path.
BYO-IPFS users have a separate pinFn injection path through delete flows that is not wired to the server-side unpin logic.
IPNS write auth is cryptographic (documented in .planning/notes/ipns-write-auth-is-cryptographic.md).
Vault blobs get quota rows via pinned_cids — all server-side pins are tracked.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global Kubo pin/rm on a CID that content-addressed dedup may share with another user — a non-malicious orphan-creation vector.
Unpin handler passes CID string directly to Kubo without reading req.user — no ownership check exists.
Kubo v0.40 configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed (tcp+udp). Server profile keeps public DHT participation — pinned CIDs are harvestable by crawlers.
Web client ignores unpin errors via .catch(logger.warn) — no caller currently reads the unpin HTTP response code.
FUSE write path and mkdir conflict region — source of the data-loss-before-remote-commit and mkdir-parent-publish-orphan bugs addressed in Phase 43.
SDK queue and queue_publish mechanics underpin FUSE durability guarantees; temp file lifecycle is the key invariant for Phase 43 fix.

workflow: GSD manager runs discuss inline but plan/execute inline on Claude Code (not backgrounded) because backgrounded agents cannot nest the plan-checker subagents.
Session rate limits can interrupt a discuss flow mid-phase; the workflow resumes cleanly in a new context window using the CHECKPOINT.json written after each locked area.
Phase context artifacts (CONTEXT.md, DISCUSSION-LOG.md, CHECKPOINT.json) should be committed to git immediately after each discuss session to make them visible to background plan/execute agents.
Presenting options menus when the user asked a direct factual question caused friction — direct answers should precede any option menus.
Checking Kubo config in deploy compose files (not just source) was necessary to resolve the DHT exposure question accurately.

friction: Assistant failed to answer the user's direct questions about CID discoverability and endpoint exposure, instead re-presenting an options menu — user explicitly called this out and had to ask again.
Session hit a usage/rate limit mid-discussion of Phase 42 after the first decision was locked, requiring the user to re-send their last message to continue.
Phase 44 git commit silently failed on the first attempt; required a manual check of git log, a retry, and a separate verification that STATE.md was included.
open_items: Wire provider.unpin into BYO-IPFS delete flows — explicitly deferred from Phase 42 scope.

Read-only pin-ls drift detection job (compare Kubo pin ls vs pinned_cids ∪ pending_unpins) for pre-existing historical orphans and defense-in-depth — deferred, not load-bearing after outbox is implemented.
Per-CID Postgres advisory xact lock (hash(cid)) needed to close the concurrent-unpin refcount race in the Phase 42 implementation.
Uniform 403 vs silent 2XX oracle-risk guidance should be documented for future API consumers — current no-caller-reads-response assumption will not hold indefinitely.
